notes.subject: ol man bikpela tru long bodi
notes.rationale: גדלי בשר: samting olsema 'bikpela long mit' — KJV 'great of flesh'; YLT 'great of appetite' — tupela lain i no wankain.

translation: Na yu wokim pasin bilong salim bodi long ol pikinini man bilong Mitsrayim, ol man i stap klostu long yu, ol man bikpela tru long bodi, na yu barimbarim ⟨את⟩ pasin bilong salim bodi bilong yu, bilong mekim bel hevi long mi.
